rule: Spec 055 §4.3 R9 and §6.1 (TS-0 audit, unit 055-t2): every automatic String(), JSON.stringify(), template interpolation, .message/.stack or inspect() in the explicit producers decision.ts, calls.ts and byte-evidence.ts, matched by its trimmed source line. verdict: fabric_computed (a Fabric value, a constant, a validated vocabulary or a count), mapped (the result goes through the identity rule before it is emitted), local_only (a map key, a returned value or an error that never leaves the process as telemetry), reported (a caller value emitted as given, as Python emits it) or follow_up (a site 055-t20 must bound or map when it routes the producer through the records input). A new site fails the test until it is audited here.
